question: Approve DRC-4610's triage: delete the uncalled path rather than wire it back, and ship it in its own PR after the integration?

artifacts.summary: nextProjectDelegation has exactly one reference in the repository: its own definition. The caller was dropped by 6c7bd9c (#314), not by 8d2585c as the title says - proven by walking the occurrence count commit-by-commit across the range rather than sampling the endpoints, which is what produced the wrong attribution. The Console's absent-delegation figure comes from nextRailDelegation via a seven-hop trace where every hop is a runtime call site, so the card is genuinely dead rather than merely unreferenced. Four figures in the prior killed pass were wrong and were corrected in place; the stylesheet claim was measured by deleting lines 158-195 from a copy and recounting, giving six selectors with lowest surviving use 1 and none orphaned. Also found: DRC-4589 publishes its two emission sites with the tab labels inverted. Six ACs resolve under --ac-scan, all unevidenced after a report line naming two of them literally was reworded.
